pullRequests.title: feat(steam-deck-pack): add handheld controls with built-in Deck button icons
pullRequests.author: momo1212221
pullRequests.head: feat/steam-deck-pack-submission
pullRequests.body:
Adds an experimental, self-contained Steam Deck Pack for RAC1 PAL and NTSC-U. Players get white A/B/X/Y and L1/L2/R1/R2 prompts, Steam Input gyro/right-trackpad camera input, and a minimal page under Pause → Options → Steam Deck in the game's five PAL languages.
The pack links its icon painter into its own native library; no separately installed Xbox icon mod is required. The existing Xbox painter is extracted into a shared C11 static library, preserving its colored Xbox layout. Only recognized…

pullRequests.title: feat(modern-controls): add live 1–100 camera slider and adjustable controller movement
pullRequests.author: momo1212221
pullRequests.head: feat/modern-controls
pullRequests.body:
RAC1's original camera response makes mouse/trackpad input feel constrained by stick emulation and gives players limited control over controller speed. This adds an optional Modern Controls mod (0.3.0) for PAL and NTSC-U with direct mouse and controller camera movement, independent axis sensitivity, a radial deadzone, and separate turn, first-person aim, movement-speed and acceleration/braking controls.
Controller settings apply to the physical right stick of any gamepad OpenRAC maps to its pad…

pullRequests.title: feat(multiplayer): add co-op rescue, host rally points and team tools
pullRequests.author: momo1212221
pullRequests.head: feat/multiplayer-comfort
pullRequests.body:
The existing co-op mod has no teammate rescue or shared gathering marker. This extends Multiplayer to 0.8.0 with a Team tools child page in the existing lobby and Multiplayer pause Options page, without consuming an additional native Options slot.

Co-op rescue defers a normal lethal on-foot hit at one health when another party member is present. A living teammate on the same level must remain within six game units and hold L3 + R3 continuously for three seconds. The host checks fresh presence…
